description: Stock Express 5.3.0 res.jsonp on Node 24.21.0 with service-shaped rates: framing, callback selection/sanitization and plain JSON controls.
client: scripts/record.mjs: raw HTTP/1.1 requests over a TCP socket to the container's ephemeral loopback port.
substitutions: Express 5.3.0 on Node 24.21.0 substitutes for the service's historical storefront endpoint. Express's real res.jsonp generates every frame; the handler supplies only a fixed synthetic rates object.

All Express defaults are retained, including the callback query name, query parser, ETag generation and response headers. Exact application and transitive dependency versions/integrities are locked in package-lock.json; the Node base image is pinned by digest.

The probe has no CDN cache and no application callback validator. The business service intentionally restricts callbacks to plain identifiers and caches by path; conformance must retain these policies and document differences from stock Express rather than reproducing them in the probe.
The recorded replies are decoded as data over HTTP, not executed as scripts. This set does not establish historical Express behavior or cross-origin script execution.

exchanges.name: plain-json
exchanges.description: Without a callback, Express sends the rates as ordinary JSON.

exchanges.name: show-rates
exchanges.description: A normal identifier is guarded and called in Express's JSONP frame.

exchanges.name: other-widget
exchanges.description: A later callback receives its own frame because this probe has no path-only CDN cache.

exchanges.name: identifier-symbols
exchanges.description: Dollar, underscore and digits are retained in a plain identifier.

exchanges.name: empty-callback
exchanges.description: An explicitly empty callback falls back to ordinary JSON in stock Express.

exchanges.name: sanitized-callback
exchanges.description: Stock Express sanitizes punctuation in a callback rather than applying the service's identifier-only rejection.

exchanges.name: dotted-callback
exchanges.description: Stock Express permits a dotted callback expression which the service's plain-identifier policy refuses.

exchanges.name: repeated-callback
exchanges.description: Repeated callback parameters expose Express's first-value selection before framing.
